title: Dynamics Among Borderline Personality and Anxiety Features in Psychotherapy Outpatients: An Exploration of Nomothetic and Idiographic Patterns
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited scope of symptoms measured (only 3 BPD and 3 anxiety symptoms); - Potential measurement limitations due to self-report; - Assumption of weak stationarity may not hold for individuals in active treatment.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are available. The authors mention using GIMME, which is an R package, but do not state if the code is publicly available. Data availability is not mentioned in the paper.
